steps.name: setup-ceiling-fixture-aircon
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setRoomCeiling('bedroom2', { style: 'tray', drop: 0.15, margin: 0.3 }); s.addItem({ defId: 'ceiling-light', position: [4.5, 1.0], rotation: 0, props: {} }); s.addElectricalPoint({ x: 5.8, z: 0.4, kind: 'aircon' }); })()

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__capturedHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: assert-rcp-sheet-content
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const need = (re, label) => { if (!re.test(html)) throw new Error('missing: ' + label) }; need(/Reflected ceiling plan/, 'RCP sheet title'); need(/FFL to false ceiling: 2450mm \(Tray\)/, 'tray zone note (hand-computed: 2.6m ceiling - 0.15m drop)'); need(/stroke-dasharray="4 3"/, 'tray inset dashed rect'); need(/class="rcp-fixture"/, 'ceiling-fixture symbol'); need(/>CL</, 'ceiling-light glyph marking'); need(/class="rcp-aircon"/, 'aircon symbol'); need(/>AC</, 'aircon glyph marking'); need(/200mm/, 'fixture X wall-offset dimension (hand-computed)'); need(/300mm/, 'fixture Z wall-offset dimension (hand-computed)'); need(/class="legend"/, 'legend/schedule block'); window.__rcpOk = true; })()

steps.name: assert-onplan-marks
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; if (!/font-weight="700" fill="#be123c"[^>]*>D1</.test(html)) throw new Error('missing on-plan D1 mark callout'); window.__marksOk = true; })()

steps.name: scroll-to-rcp-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const nameEl = names.find((el) => el.textContent.trim().startsWith('Reflected ceiling plan')); const target = nameEl && nameEl.closest('.sheet'); if (!target) throw new Error('RCP sheet not found in rendered document'); target.scrollIntoView(); })()
